formulas.ascii: Z = [1, X, Wy]; H = [1, X, WX] (instrumentOrder 2 adds W^2 X); P = H (H'H)^-1 H'. delta = (Z'PZ)^-1 Z'P y; u = y - Z delta; sigma2 = u'u/n; se_j = sqrt(sigma2 [(Z'PZ)^-1]_jj); z_j = delta_j/se_j with a standard-normal p-value. The constant is centred out; the intercept is ybar - mean(Z) delta. Anselin-Kelejian AK = n I_u^2/phi2 with I_u = (n/S0) u'Wu/u'u tests the residuals for spatial autocorrelation. Classical (non-robust) standard errors.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
